item.title: Nasu Highlands & Mount Chausu: A Volcanic Resort Above the Clouds — Guide
item.description: The Nasu Highlands, centred on the active volcanic peak of Mount Chausu (1,915 m), have been a favoured cool-climate retreat since the imperial family established a summer villa here in the early 20th century. A ropeway carries visitors partway up the still-steaming volcano for panoramic views and hiking trails across the crater rim, while the surrounding highland resort area hosts a changing calendar of seasonal events, from spring flower festivals to summer outdoor concerts and autumn foliage celebrations.
